items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury and no Friday practice; Rams optimistic after feeling better Saturday.
items.why: Calf minor per McVay; no setbacks.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; reverse any Davante/backup beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected in favorable matchup.

items.text: Breece Hall inactive vs Dolphins (quad); was GTD-pessimistic after limited practice and not full participant post 3-game absence.
items.why: Unlikely per sources; early return attempt failed full work.
items.implication: Braelon Allen locked RB1/2 in good matchup; Hall managers sit.
items.opportunity: Full carries/snaps for backup RB committee lead.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle/high-ankle sprain) for Week 7 vs Bengals after earlier Q tag; third straight miss, Huntley starts again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday; limited practice, high ankle.
items.implication: Ravens pass game and red-zone efficiency drop; avoid Lamar, stream Huntley only in deep/2QB.
items.opportunity: Increased looks possible for Flowers/Andrews/Likely in safer scripts.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT for Eagles MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thin; elevated TE/Goedert and remaining WRs; Saquon still expected.
items.opportunity: Target share spike for Goedert and any active Eagles pass-catchers; reverse prior WR beneficiaries if any.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday vs Colts not significant; day-to-day per source.
items.implication: Likely available Week 8; monitor practice. Mason was activated earlier.
items.opportunity: If limited, Mason/handcuffs rise in MIN backfield.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) actually hurt but not certain on severity; was expected lead back pregame vs Texans.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 8; Tracy also hamstring, committee risk.
items.opportunity: If out next, backups rise; reverse lead-back assumption.
items.conflict: Berry hated the HOU matchup already.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide late; almost certainly fine, would be tilting if serious from smart non-score.
items.why: Purposeful slide mechanics; no indication of severity.
items.implication: No downgrade for next week; continue as elite RB1.
items.opportunity: Full role intact vs any handcuff worry.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (questionable but projected in) for MNF vs Cowboys after hamstring return to practice.
items.implication: Strong start in elite RB matchup vs Dallas; volume RB1.
items.opportunity: Near-full snap/carry share likely if active.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated/IN and expected after exempt list; returns from layoff for Packers vs Lions.
items.implication: Workload uncertain post-layoff; monitor snaps vs committee.
items.opportunity: Lead back role but rust risk; handcuff Wilson elevated if limited.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (game 2 without Rice); has never topped 83 rec yards in 37 games despite volume.
items.implication: Volume there but historical ceiling cap; fade pure upside or pair carefully.
items.opportunity: Primary WR route runner while Rice out; monitor efficiency.

items.text: Jets WRs with AD Mitchell back: Garrett Wilson 29 routes, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgts career-to-date limited), Mitchell 18 on 33 Geno dropbacks.
items.implication: Wilson remains clear WR1; Cooper efficiency intrigue if volume sticks.
items.opportunity: Wilson high route share; secondary WRs fighting for leftovers.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (usage/matchup vs CHI) and Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET defense allowing TE TDs/points).
items.why: Bears yardage-friendly; Lions TE-vulnerable (9 TE TDs).
items.implication: Start with confidence in PPR/volume spots.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/red-zone share in positive matchups.

items.text: Loves volume RBs Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR) for big workloads in friendly matchups; Saquon if active.
items.why: Workload + defenses carved by RBs; Dallas soft vs Saquon.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (Gonzalez shadow), Josh Downs (low target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough SEA D), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff), Cam Skattebo (brutal HOU spot).
items.why: Shadows, role/target issues, tough Ds, rust, matchup.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats this week.
items.conflict: Jacobs IN but still hated on workload; Skattebo now also hurt.
